verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of API versioning (such as version identifiers or version pinning) and no published deprecation policy (such as notice periods or sunset timelines). Migration guides from TokBox/OpenTok and continued TokBox portal access are adjacent transition material, not a versioning or deprecation policy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
